short_description: Street Fighter 6 reignites the fighting game fire! Featuring a vibrant new roster, stunning visuals, and innovative gameplay, it's the ultimate battle for the streets.
In the Louisiana bayou, 1896, become a bounty hunter. Hunt monstrous creatures, compete with rivals, and survive the unforgiving wilderness in this tense, tactical PvPvE experience.
Explore a vast, post-apocalyptic world in Wuthering Waves, an open-world action RPG with stunning visuals, dynamic combat, and a compelling story.
Arma Reforger is a military sandbox shooter offering authentic combat and intense multiplayer action. Experience realistic tactics and persistent war on a massive scale.
Survive the hazardous moons! Gather scrap, manage your crew, and escape before the deadly creatures of Lethal Company hunt you down.
"Arena Breakout: Infinite" is a hardcore, tactical first-person shooter where players loot and escape dangerous combat zones. Gear up, fight, and survive!
Explore a post-apocalyptic city battling mysterious creatures in **Zenless Zone Zero**. Fast-paced combat and stylish characters await as you uncover the truth.
Survive, thrive, and dominate a prehistoric island teeming with dinosaurs and other players in this enhanced next-gen remake of ARK: Survival Evolved.
Civilization VII: Build an empire from the Stone Age to the stars. Explore, expand, exploit, and exterminate your way to world domination through diplomacy, war, and cultural achievements.
SMITE 2 is the next generation of the MOBA featuring mythology's greatest gods. Experience stunning visuals, enhanced gameplay, and strategic team battles.
A vast open-world MMORPG where players fight for control of a dynamic world, battling both creatures and rival factions for dominion.
Survive and thrive in a fallen world, battling hordes, crafting, and exploring a vast, voxel-based landscape in this action RPG. Uncover ancient secrets.
Survive the abandoned Playtime Co. factory! Unravel the mysteries, solve puzzles, and outsmart Huggy Wuggy and other terrifying toys in this episodic horror adventure.
Team up in "It Takes Two," a co-op adventure where a fractured couple must overcome obstacles using unique, connected abilities to rediscover their love.
Chaos reigns! Enter ancient China in DYNASTY WARRIORS: ORIGINS, facing hordes as legendary warriors. Unleash Musou attacks and conquer epic battlefields!
NHL 25 delivers fast-paced hockey action with enhanced gameplay, updated rosters, and immersive visuals, offering the ultimate hockey experience.
Balatro is a deck-building roguelike where you play poker hands for powerful, score-boosting synergies.  Combine cards for explosive, addictive gameplay.
Dive into a vibrant world as a tiny creature, exploring interconnected environments, solving puzzles, and uncovering hidden secrets in MiSide, a charming platformer!
Journey through a world on the brink of chaos in Metaphor: Refantazio. Command the powers of the Traveler to shape destiny, forging bonds and battling for your future.

game_title: Indiana Jones and the Great Circle
short_description: Step into the boots of Indiana Jones! Explore ancient mysteries, battle Nazis, and unravel a global conspiracy in this thrilling first-person adventure.
Hell Let Loose is a brutal, realistic World War II FPS focused on large-scale infantry battles and intense squad-based combat. Communication and teamwork are key to survival.
Leap, bound, and explore! Mario's first 3D adventure sees him collecting stars to rescue Princess Peach from Bowser in a vibrant, unforgettable world.
Explore the desolate Zone of alienation in S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2. Survive brutal anomalies, uncover the secrets of Chernobyl, and fight for survival.
STALCRAFT: X plunges you into the desolate Zone, blending immersive survival with brutal PvP and thrilling PvE encounters in a post-apocalyptic world.
Team up with friends in Supermarket Together! Cooperate to stock shelves, check out customers, and manage a chaotic supermarket before closing time!
Embark on a vibrant MMORPG adventure in Ragnarok Online 2! Explore a vast world, choose your class, and team up to battle mythical creatures and uncover ancient secrets.
"The Outlast Trials" plunges you into a terrifying experiment, forcing you to endure psychological and physical torture alone or with friends. Survive the trials or succumb to madness.
In Detroit, androids are sentient. Play as three androids and shape their fates as they fight for freedom and challenge humanity's control in this interactive drama.
EA Sports UFC 2 delivers realistic MMA action with stunning visuals and improved gameplay. Featuring a deep roster of fighters and a variety of game modes.
Cozy up in Palia, a vibrant MMO where you build a life, make friends, and uncover the mysteries of a lost world, all without combat!
Survive the Amazon rainforest in Green Hell! Fight hunger, thirst, and psychological torment in this unforgiving open-world survival simulator. Craft, build, and fight for your life.
Soar through stunningly realistic skies! Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 delivers the ultimate aviation experience with dynamic world simulations and thrilling career paths.
A strategic autobattler where you build a team of champions, position them tactically, and battle against seven other players to be the last one standing.
Explore a procedurally generated galaxy! Discover planets, build bases, fight space battles, and uncover the mysteries of a vast, shared universe in No Man's Sky.
Cultivate your dream farm in Farming Simulator 25! Expand your operations with new crops, vehicles, and animals across diverse global landscapes.
Fight for Washington D.C. in The Division 2, a looter-shooter RPG where you battle factions and rebuild society after a deadly pandemic.
Fight alongside iconic video game characters in explosive battles! Smash Bros. Ultimate features the largest roster ever, countless stages, and endless fun for all ages.
Survive a zombie apocalypse in Dying Light! Parkour through a vast, infected city during the day, and fight for your life against relentless hordes at night.
1943 France: Disrupt the Nazi occupation as an elite Allied sniper. Utilize stealth, tactical weaponry, and satisfying X-ray kills to liberate the Resistance and sabotage key operations.
Explore the mysterious island of Aeternum in New World, where you'll battle fantastical creatures, forge your destiny, and carve out your place in a savage, player-driven world.
Join Hello Kitty and friends on a vibrant island! Build friendships, craft, explore, and decorate in this adorable, relaxing adventure game.
Run a chaotic, satirical news show in a world where everyone's a bizarre celebrity. Juggle breaking news, manage your outlandish staff, and craft the perfect headline!
Dive into the world of "Mir Tankov" (World of Tanks), a free-to-play online multiplayer game featuring epic tank battles and historical vehicles.
Isaac faces horrific trials in a randomly generated dungeon. Utilize tears, pickups, and transformations to survive gruesome bosses and uncover dark secrets.
Exoborne is an open-world extraction shooter where you fight for survival in a ravaged, dynamic world. Gear up, scavenge, and battle both environment and rivals.
Explore the vast open world of San Andreas in this action-adventure game. Steal cars, complete missions, and rise through the ranks of the criminal underworld.
Embark on a stylish adventure in Infinity Nikki, a dress-up RPG! Explore vast worlds, solve puzzles, and craft stunning outfits to overcome challenges with Nikki and her sidekick, Momo.
Blast your way through mayhem! Borderlands 3 offers chaotic gunplay, a vast galaxy to explore, and tons of customizable weapons and Vault Hunters.
Knight Online is a classic MMORPG where players battle monsters, participate in PvP wars, and build a character in a fantasy world.
Manage your own supermarket! Stock shelves, handle finances, and deal with customers in this realistic and challenging simulation.
